connected: ✅ MedControl is connected. Dose reminders and lab alerts will come here.
passwordChanged: 🔑 The MedControl password was changed: other sessions were ended, the Apple Health key and AI agent tokens were revoked. If this was not you, sign in and change the password.
passwordReset: 🔑 The MedControl password was reset with the recovery code: other sessions were ended, the Apple Health key and AI agent tokens were revoked. If this was not you, sign in and change the password.
recoveryCode: 🔑 A new password recovery code was created in MedControl, the old one no longer works. If this was not you, change the password.
allSessionsEnded: 🔒 All MedControl sessions were ended, the Apple Health key and AI agent tokens were revoked. Sign in again.
passkeyAdded: 🔑 A new passkey "{name}" was added to MedControl. If this was not you, delete it in Settings → "Sign-in and security" and change the password.
passkeyRemoved: 🔑 A passkey was removed from MedControl. If this was not you, change the password.
telegramChanged: 🔔 The Telegram bot or chat of MedControl was changed: reminders and security messages may no longer come to this chat. If this was not you, sign in, press “Sign out everywhere” in Settings → “Sign-in and security” and change the password.
mcpOn: 🤖 Access for AI agents (MCP) was turned on in MedControl. If this was not you, turn it off in Settings and change the password.
mcpOff: 🤖 Access for AI agents (MCP) was turned off, all tokens were revoked.
mcpToken: 🔑 AI agent token "{name}" was created ({scope}). If this was not you, revoke it in Settings.
viewerClosed: The image viewer is closed: open the Imaging section in MedControl and press "Open images" again.
